abstracts.abstract: This Act adds virtual currency to the money laundering definition in the criminal code and gives the State legal authority to attempt to return virtual currency for victims. It also provides that if money cannot be returned to the victims of the crime, or are outside of the United States, it should be disposed of per order of the Superior Court.

bill.title: AN ACT TO AMEND TITLE 11 OF THE DELAWARE CODE RELATING TO VIRTUAL CURRENCY.

posted_text:
💰 DE HB 465 — Delaware Now Targeting Virtual Currency in Money Laundering Cases

Delaware is taking a new step to combat financial crime. This bill adds virtual currency – like Bitcoin – to the state’s list of illegal assets used in money laundering. If you’re a Delaware resident who’s been a victim of a crime involving virtual currency, the state can now try to recover your lost funds. The law also outlines what happens to the currency if the victim is outside the U.S. – it will be handled by a court order. ...
